raise_justifications.backend/database/conversations.py: Added `delete_conversations_by_source` to support Limitless import cleanup logic. +2 for injectable Firestore deletion clients. +2 for the registered Limitless compound query.
raise_justifications.backend/database/memory_apply_store.py: Canonical apply, source replacement, lineage, and projection-outbox writes must remain one atomic Firestore transaction boundary; splitting this owner would reintroduce split mutation authority (FC-split-mutation-authority). +11 routes stored lineage reactivation validation through the shared malformed-document read boundary while retaining atomic conflict semantics (#9494/#9696).
raise_justifications.backend/database/users.py: Account-deletion marker fencing and recursive missing-root cleanup must remain beside the existing deletion transaction and collection traversal; extracting them would duplicate the durable lifecycle authority. +33 for the queue-before-auth recovery guard and +16 for the job-id-fenced repeat-dispatch transaction. +74 for the server-owned, expiring city-context consent record and revocation cache cleanup: both belong next to the existing user-document access boundary so Redis is never authorization authority (SCA-174). +16 keeps the uncached deletion-state normalization and atomic pending admission beside the transaction that owns that marker so auth and queue dispatch cannot consult competing lifecycle authority (SCA-280). +36 keeps injectable deletion reads and a durable late-Agent-VM cleanup record with the marker that drives retry dispatch. +21 persists and validates the provider numeric-ID fence on that deletion-owned late-cleanup record. +7 exposes the deletion-marker transaction that upgrades pre-fence retry records before provider cleanup.
